description: The plot illustrates how evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) varies with the “Activated Parameters Ratio(%)” for several model variants, shown as four lines with a legend. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio(%)”, uses a linear scale, and spans from 100 down to 25 (values shown include 100, 75, 50, and 25, with ticks at these intervals). The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL”, uses a linear scale, and ranges approximately from 11.5 to 14.0 with tick marks at 0.5 increments (11.5, 12.0, 12.5, 13.0, 13.5, 14.0). The “Transformer” line is red, dashed, with no visible markers, and increases gradually from about 11.7 at 100% to about 13.0 at 25%. The “Only MoHD FFN” line is gray with square markers and a solid line, rising from about 11.6 at 100% to about 13.2 at 25%, with intermediate points near 12.0 at 75% and about 12.2 at 50%. The “Only MoHD ATTN” line is dark blue with circular markers and a solid line, increasing from about 11.6 at 100% to roughly 14.8 at 25%, passing near 12.1 at 75% and about 13.2 at 50%. The “MoHD ATTN + MLP” line is bright blue with x-shaped markers and a solid line, increasing from about 11.6 at 100% to about 14.3 at 25%, with points near 12.0 at 75% and about 13.0 at 50%.
